description: End-to-end phone number verification purchase and execution flow for TaaS/camera number verification, from searching capabilities and pricing to creating a verification session, submitting evidence, handling retries, and final confirmation and reporting.

cart_id.description: Cart identifier for pending verification purchase

verification_id.description: Verification session identifier for a specific target number

target_msisdn.description: E.164 formatted phone number to verify

evidence_id.description: Identifier of submitted verification evidence artifact

functions.name: search_verification_products
functions.description: Search number verification product offerings and supported methods by country, carrier, risk level, and integration constraints.

query.description: Free-text search across product name, method, and capabilities (e.g., 'KYC', 'SIM swap', 'roaming').

preferred_carriers.description: Carrier names or IDs to prioritize.

risk_tier.description: Required risk handling tier for fraud/abuse.

data_residency.description: Preferred data residency region for processing/storage.

consent_required.description: If true, only return products that can enforce end-user consent capture.

retention_days_max.description: Maximum acceptable retention period for evidence and logs.

synchronous_required.description: Whether a synchronous (blocking) verification result is required.

functions.returns: Paginated list of verification products with supported methods, coverage hints, estimated latency, and base pricing metadata.

functions.name: get_verification_product_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed configuration, coverage, limitations, and parameter requirements for a specific verification product.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code for tailoring coverage/constraints.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code for showing price examples.

functions.returns: Product details including method-specific required fields, constraints (OTP lengths, resend limits), compliance notes, and pricing tiers when available.

functions.name: check_number_eligibility
functions.description: Pre-flight check for whether a target MSISDN is eligible for selected verification methods and optional signals (carrier reachability, line type, roaming, ported).

project_id.description: Project identifier for policy and credentials.

country_hint.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country hint to speed parsing.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for language preferences (e.g., en-US).

collected.description: Whether end-user consent has been collected.

requested_methods.description: Verification methods to test eligibility for.

ip_address.description: End-user IP address for geo match, if available.

min_age_days_since_port.description: Minimum days since number porting to be eligible.

max_sim_swap_days.description: If SIM swap within this many days, mark as high risk.

functions.returns: Eligibility results per target including normalized number, carrier/line type, reachable/blocked status, and method availability with reasons.

functions.name: create_pricing_quote
functions.description: Create a pricing quote for a set of verification items (single or batch), including method mix, signals, SLA, and regional pricing rules.

project_id.description: Project identifier used for pricing agreements and policies.

target_msisdn.description: E.164 number to verify (optional for generic bulk quote).

quantity.description: Number of verifications for this line item.

signals.description: Optional signals billed per verification depending on plan.

billing_country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 billing country for tax estimation.

functions.returns: Quote with itemized pricing, taxes/fees estimates, expiration timestamp, and a quote_id.

functions.name: create_verification_cart
functions.description: Create a cart from a quote and configure execution-level settings such as webhooks, idempotency, and verification policies.

quote_id.description: Quote identifier to convert into a cart.

customer_id.description: Customer identifier to bind the cart.

secret.description: Secret for HMAC or bearer token; not required for none/mtls depending on setup.

header_name.description: Custom header name for signature/token, if applicable.

key.description: Client-generated idempotency key for cart creation.

velocity_limit_per_msisdn_per_hour.description: Block or throttle repeated attempts per number per hour.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the cart.

functions.returns: Cart summary including cart_id, line items, totals, and cart expiration.

functions.name: get_verification_cart
functions.description: Fetch the current cart including line items, totals, taxes, applied discounts, and execution settings.
functions.returns: Cart details, including validation warnings (e.g., missing consent, unsupported carrier) and payable total.

functions.name: update_verification_cart
functions.description: Modify cart items or execution settings (e.g., add/remove targets, change method, adjust OTP settings).

cart_item_id.description: Identifier of the cart line item.

client_reference.description: Client-side identifier to map results back.

sender_id.description: Optional sender ID, if supported in the region.

functions.returns: Updated cart with recalculated totals, validations, and any item-level errors.

functions.name: create_verification_checkout
functions.description: Initialize checkout from a cart, collecting billing profile, tax info, and payment intent configuration.

allowed_payment_methods.description: Restrict payment methods available for this checkout.

functions.returns: Checkout session (checkout_id) with finalized totals, tax breakdown, and available payment methods.

functions.name: process_verification_payment
functions.description: Process payment for a checkout session; on success, creates a verification order and allocates verification capacity.

reference.description: Customer reference to appear on transfer.

payment_method.description: Polymorphic payment method object; include the matching sub-object for the chosen type.

return_url.description: URL to return user after 3DS challenge.

idempotency_key.description: Client idempotency key for payment processing.

functions.returns: Payment result including payment_id, status (succeeded/processing/failed), and on success a verification_order_id with allocated items.

functions.name: create_verification_session
functions.description: Create a verification session under a paid order for a specific target MSISDN, selecting method and challenge configuration.

client_reference.description: Client reference to correlate downstream events.

expected_last_digits.description: Optional: expected caller ID last digits presented to user.

ip_address.description: End-user device IP used for network auth match, if required.

functions.returns: Created verification session with verification_id, initial status, and next_action (e.g., send OTP, upload evidence, wait).

functions.name: submit_verification_evidence
functions.description: Submit evidence to complete a verification session (OTP code, flash call digits, network auth token, or document/selfie artifacts).

otp_code.description: OTP code as entered by user.

flash_call_digits.description: Digits observed from incoming call or caller ID.

silent_network_token.description: Token from device/network auth SDK or redirect flow.

url.description: Pre-uploaded file URL accessible to the service.

text.description: Consent disclosure text shown to end-user.

evidence.description: Polymorphic evidence payload; include fields corresponding to evidence.type.

functions.returns: Evidence acceptance result with evidence_id, updated verification status, and any next_action/required_additional_evidence.

functions.name: get_verification_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and detailed outcome of a verification session, including signals and audit trail.
functions.returns: Verification status (pending/succeeded/failed/expired/canceled) with decision reasons, attempt counters, and included expansions.

functions.name: retry_verification
functions.description: Retry a verification by resending a challenge, switching method, or resetting attempts within policy limits.

cooldown_override_seconds.description: Optional override if allowed by policy.

max_total_retries.description: Client-specified cap; service may enforce lower caps.

functions.returns: Retry outcome including updated status, new challenge metadata (if applicable), and remaining retries/attempts.

functions.name: cancel_verification_order
functions.description: Cancel a verification order (or specific verification sessions) and attempt refund/credit if eligible; used for rollback/error recovery.
functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation including canceled entities, refund/credit status, and updated order status.

functions.name: search_verification_orders

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of number verification order summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: import_verification_orders

functions.name: subscribe_to_verification_order_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive number verification order lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.name: get_verification_order_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a number verification order, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the number verification order, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for number verification orders using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

functions.name: add_verification_order_comment

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a number verification order (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for number verification orders over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for number verification orders combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the number verification order context.
